slides.title: Did you say yes, or *feel guilty?*
slides.sub: A short audit of what's on your plate, and why.

slides.title: List your yeses
slides.body: Every commitment you're carrying this month. The favors, the plans, the 'sure, I can do that.'

slides.title: Mark the guilty ones
slides.body: Next to each, ask: did I want this, or did I say yes so I wouldn't feel bad saying no?

slides.title: Notice the weight
slides.body: Guilt yeses tend to sit heavier. They're the ones you keep putting off, then resent doing.

slides.title: Pick one to rethink
slides.body: Not all of them. One. Finish it with a clear head, or tell the truth about it. Then watch your next yes.
